source: SSC MTS and Havaldar examination notice (ssc.gov.in) and past paper pattern
intro: The CBT has two sessions. Session 1 covers numerical and reasoning ability, Session 2 covers general awareness and English. The paper is set at a basic level, so accuracy on easy questions decides the score.
note: The topic lists follow the broad areas SSC publishes in its notice. SSC does not give a chapter-wise list, so use these as a checklist and treat the questions asked in the past papers as the guide to depth.

sections.name: Numerical and Mathematical Ability
topics: Number system, whole numbers, decimals and fractions, relationship between numbers
Time and distance, time and work
Basic mensuration: area and perimeter of simple figures

sections.name: Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving
topics: Coding and decoding, relationships, direction sense
Spatial visualisation and orientation, visual memory, observation
Arithmetical reasoning, problem solving, decision making

sections.name: General Awareness
topics: Current events of national and international importance
India and its neighbours: history, culture, geography, economic scene, polity
Sports, awards, books and authors, important days
General science as seen in everyday life and research
Static GK: first in India, organisations, schemes, national parks and similar fact tables

sections.name: English Language and Comprehension
topics: Vocabulary: synonyms, antonyms, one-word substitution, idioms
Grammar: error spotting, fill in the blanks, tenses, voice and speech
Sentence structure and comprehension of a short passage
